_doc: The minor-slot enchantment stable (bug bash 3.3.2; docs/design/ARMOR_REDESIGN_PLAN.md section 7; src/enchantments.py). Every enchantment is found only on its slot. Guard ladders are the model's (tools/balance/armor_model.py: each priced to the same budget of 0.41 / 0.46 / 0.51 / 0.56 / 0.61 AC points by tier, rising, fitted so tier V is never weaker than IV); 'tiers' gives tier I..V and src/enchantments.py makes the ten levels (a tier's lesser form takes its value, its greater form the halfway point to the next). 'from_tier' is the first tier the enchantment rolls at, 'skip_tiers' tiers it does not (where its threat is too rare to be worth the slot). 'weight' is its share of its slot's rolls (guards are rolled most).
